videos.title: ASML：揭開 High NA EUV 的面貌
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「雙重圖案化製程」的延伸背景。辨認曝光系統的光學、載台與整合規模；動畫為導覽，不是組裝施工圖。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Double-patterning lithography. Identify the optics, stages and integration scale of an exposure system; the animation is a tour, not assembly drawings. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 找出光罩與晶圓所處的不同位置。
觀察光學系統與精密運動系統如何配合。
把解析度能力與層間對準能力分開記錄。
watchForEn: Locate the distinct positions of mask and wafer.
Observe cooperation between optics and precision motion.
Record resolution capability separately from layer-to-layer alignment.
videos.before: 先問：「將密集線分成兩種顏色」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Split dense lines into two colors requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after:
把「畫出套刻偏移造成的交替間距」列為查證任務：相對位移會產生間距交替。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 45/35 nm 與不合格理由，明確指出平均值盲點。
videos.afterEn:
Follow-up evidence task for Sketch alternating spaces caused by overlay shift: Relative displacement produces alternating spacing. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 45/35 nm and the failure reason, identifying the mean-value blind spot.

related.differenceEn: Two lithography steps and two spacer cycles have different overlay and thickness error chains.

courses.summary: 雙重圖案化製程涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Double-patterning lithography involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

history.title: imec 在魯汶成立
history.text: 官方總部沿革將魯汶列為 1984 年發展的起點。
history.textEn: The official headquarters history identifies Leuven as the 1984 starting point.

history.title: 公開混合圖案化整合案例
history.text: imec 說明 SAQP 與 EUV 阻擋圖案化如何共同服務金屬層整合。這是產業研發沿革，不表示本課程全部技術於當年或此地發明。
history.textEn: imec described combining SAQP and EUV block patterning for metal-layer integration. This is research history, not a claim that every course technology was invented there or then.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.

roles.role: 浸潤式曝光機是多重曝光的基礎，可對照疊對誤差分配。
roles.roleEn: Immersion scanners underpin multiple exposures, relevant to overlay-error allocation.
roles.business: EUV、DUV 微影與圖案化量測系統。

roles.role: 提供光阻與硬遮罩材料，可對照曝光與轉移。
roles.roleEn: Supplies resists and hard-mask materials, relevant to exposure and transfer.
roles.business: 矽晶圓、光阻、光罩基板與稀土磁石等材料。
roles.businessEn: Silicon wafers, photoresists, photomask substrates and rare-earth magnets among other materials.

roles.role: 提供塗佈顯影與蝕刻設備，可對照本課的 LELE 與自我對準流程比較。
roles.roleEn: Supplies coater/developers and etch tools, relevant to comparing LELE and self-aligned flows here.
roles.business: 塗佈顯影、蝕刻、沉積、熱處理、清洗與晶圓接合設備。
roles.businessEn: Coater/developers, etch, deposition, thermal-processing, cleaning and wafer-bonding equipment.

courses.connection: 從「雙重圖案化製程」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Double-patterning lithography. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
